# Cardi-OH

> A collaborative of Ohio's medical schools improving cardiovascular and diabetes outcomes for Medicaid populations through evidence-based education, quality improvement initiatives, and clinical best practices.

Cardi-OH is a multidisciplinary collaborative leveraging expertise from Ohio's seven medical schools to disseminate cardiovascular and diabetes best practices to primary care teams across the state. The organization uses Project ECHO clinics, webinars, podcasts, and quality improvement toolkits to address health disparities and improve medication adherence and clinical outcomes for Ohio Medicaid patients.

## About Cardi-OH

- [Cardi-OH Homepage](https://www.cardi-oh.org): Improving cardiovascular and diabetes outcomes for Ohio Medicaid
- [Overview](https://www.cardi-oh.org/about/overview): Cardi-OH collaborative overview and mission for Ohio Medicaid populations
- [Our Mission, Vision & Values](https://www.cardi-oh.org/about/our-mission-vision-values): Cardi-OH mission, vision, and core values guiding the organization
- [Who We Are](https://www.cardi-oh.org/about/who-we-are): Leadership team and multidisciplinary experts from Ohio's medical schools
- [What We Do](https://www.cardi-oh.org/about/what-we-do): Cardi-OH activities: disseminating evidence-based best practices via Project ECHO

## Quality Improvement & Programs

- [Quality Improvement](https://www.cardi-oh.org/about/quality-improvement): Quality Improvement Projects for hypertension and diabetes management in Medicaid
- [Education & ECHO Clinics](https://www.cardi-oh.org/education): Educational opportunities through statewide webinars and ECHO Clinics for clinicians
- [Web App](https://www.cardi-oh.org/about/web-app): Mobile and desktop web app for accessing Cardi-OH resource library

## Clinical Resources & Guidelines

- [Resources Library](https://www.cardi-oh.org/resources): Comprehensive resource library with articles, videos, ECHO tools, and QIP Toolkit
- [Key Updates from the 2026 ADA Standards of Care](https://www.cardi-oh.org/resources/current-59--key-updates-from-the-2026-ada-standards-of-care): 2026 ADA Standards updates: CGM, weight loss, blood pressure, and nutrition guidance
- [Guide to Therapeutic Interchange of Insulin Products](https://www.cardi-oh.org/resources/guide-to-therapeutic-interchange-of-insulin-products-for-safe-and-effective-transitions-in-diabetes-management): Provider guide on insulin product interchange for cost containment and treatment access

## Educational Podcasts & Capsules

- [Podcast 65 - Beyond the Traditional Lipid Panel: Emerging Biomarkers in Cardiovascular Risk](https://www.cardi-oh.org/resources/podcast-65--beyond-the-traditional-lipid-panel-emerging-biomarkers-in-cardiovascular-risk): Podcast on apolipoprotein B and lipoprotein(a) biomarkers for cardiovascular risk
- [Podcast 64 - Is Metformin Still the First-Line Treatment for Type 2 Diabetes?](https://www.cardi-oh.org/resources/podcast-64--is-metformin-still-the-first-line-treatment-for-type-2-diabetes): Podcast on metformin and newer type 2 diabetes therapeutics per ADA guidelines
- [Podcast 63 - Rethinking Prescription Labels: A Patient-Centered Approach](https://www.cardi-oh.org/resources/podcast-63--rethinking-prescription-labels-a-patient-centered-approach): Podcast on improving prescription label readability and patient medication adherence
- [Capsule 64 - Depression, Anxiety, and Cardiovascular Disease Risk](https://www.cardi-oh.org/resources/capsule-64--depression-anxiety-and-cardiovascular-disease-risk): Educational capsule on integrating mental health screening into cardiovascular care
- [Capsule 63 - Strength Training for Older Adults](https://www.cardi-oh.org/resources/capsule-63--strength-training-for-older-adults): Clinical guide on safe strength training strategies for older adult patients

## Webinars & Evidence Summaries

- [From Prescription to Practice: Tackling Adherence Challenges in Clinical Care](https://www.cardi-oh.org/resources/from-prescription-to-practice-tackling-adherence-challenges-in-clinical-care): Webinar on treatment adherence barriers and communication strategies for clinicians
- [Tailored Text Messages Enhance Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP) Readiness and Enrollment](https://www.cardi-oh.org/resources/current-58--tailored-text-messages-enhance-diabetes-prevention-program-dpp-readiness-and-enrollment): Evidence on text-based diabetes prevention intervention using Stages of Change model
